DOCKET NO. 59475

SUPPLEMENTAL EXHIBIT TO PUBLIC COMMENT OF DARIAN STERN (ITEM
NO. 6643)

REGARDING ROUTE LINK G31 AND TRACT 2168


To the Honorable Public Utility Commission of Texas:

We previously filed a public comment in this docket (stamped as Item No. 6643) detailing the
severe negative impacts that proposed Route Link G31 would have on Tract 2168. Specifically, I
noted that this parcel serves as the established grounds for the annual Briggs & Oakalla
Community Fireworks, contrary to preliminary routing studies that erroneously labeled the land
as "vacant, unimproved pasture."

To substantiate this claim and build the evidentiary record regarding the protection of community
values under PURA § 37.056, I am submitting this supplemental filing.

Attached are four printed historical records from local media outlets documenting the ongoing,
multi-year use of this exact location for large-scale community gatherings. These published
reports prove this land is a highly utilized public asset.

Exhibits Included:

   ●​ Exhibit A: Daily Trib Article (June 25, 2026) – "Briggs and Oakalla fireworks return for
      fifth annual Fourth of July show"
   ●​ Exhibit B: Daily Trib Article (June 26, 2025) – "Highland Lakes communities celebrate
      Independence Day"
   ●​ Exhibit C: Daily Trib Article (June 29, 2022) – "Big bang Highland Lakes"
   ●​ Exhibit D: Daily Trib Article (June 23, 2021) – "Where to watch July 4 fireworks"
   ●​ Exhibit E: Hill Country Portal – July 4th Event Calendar Record



The preservation of this community space and the safety of the adjacent Northeast Burnet
County Fire Rescue medevac flight path dictate that Link G31 must be removed from
consideration.
 Respectfully submitted,



Darian Stern
Briggs and Oakalla Community Fireworks
